ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the figure is the input terminal Ui; a filter capacitor C is connected between the upper and lower buses; the upper input bus is connected to the right-side output terminal through the series pass transistor VT1; a load resistor RL is connected between the right-side output terminal and the lower bus; in the middle there is a resistor R supplying power from the input upper bus to the base node, and a voltage-regulator diode Uz is connected below the base node to the lower bus. Therefore this is a voltage-regulating circuit in which the voltage-regulator diode fixes the base voltage of VT1, and VT1 serves as a series pass transistor/emitter follower to supply power to the load. Reasoning calculation: The Zener diode voltage Uz = 10.7 V fixes the base voltage, and the base-emitter voltage drop of the silicon transistor is about 0.7 V, so the output voltage Uo ≈ 10.7 − 0.7 = 10.0 V. The load current IL = Uo / RL = 10.0 / 100 = 0.10 A. When the base current is ignored, the transistor current is approximately equal to the load current. The voltage drop borne by the transistor is about Ui − Uo = 16 − 10 = 6 V, so the transistor power dissipation PT ≈ 6 × 0.10 = 0.6 W.

推理：按图中 VT1 为串联调整管，输出节点在 VT1 的发射极/输出侧并给 RL 供电。稳压二极管电压 Uz = 10.7 V，取晶体管发射结压降约 0.7 V，则输出电压 Uo ≈ 10.7 - 0.7 = 10.0 V。负载电流 IL = Uo / RL = 10.0 / 100 = 0.10 A。按指定方法，输入源对该串联电流路径提供功率 Pi = 16 × 0.10 = 1.6 W，负载吸收功率 PL = 10.0 × 0.10 = 1.0 W，因此晶体管损耗功率 PVT1 = 1.6 - 1.0 = 0.6 W。最终答案：0.6 W。
